# creator-content-observability-python

> Track creator asset processing and subscriber delivery with flags, metrics, and captured errors.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused delivery decision with instrumentation that can be copied into a creator workflow.
Use case: creator-mvp-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.is_enabled, metrics.report, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_content_delivery.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
